text:
I'm sorry you waited a week for a reply and then lost your plant.

If the plant is within its guarantee window (30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members), you can claim a free replacement from "My Orders". Upload at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. Cases like pests introduced after delivery or deliberate neglect aren't covered.

I don't have a policy for compensation beyond the replacement, such as for the slow email response, so I can't promise any. I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like. If so, please send me your order number (LF- plus six digits) and roughly when the plant was delivered.
